title: Intake creates empty role=source stubs (null path/sha; arXiv as text/html)
description:
## Expected
Prospects either have no source attachment until accession, or stubs clearly marked incomplete. arXiv PDF prospects should not claim mediaType=text/html.

## Observed
Accepted research-proposal refs had role=source attachments with storagePath=null, sha256=null before accession. arXiv stub was text/html. Readiness still url_only so accession proceeded; stubs remain on superseded proposal lineages.
